name: doodle
description: Line with no plan: looping shapes that fill a margin, symbols repeated at different sizes, and a pen that keeps going over its own edges.

prompt.default: a doodle: looping unbroken ballpoint lines, small repeated symbols at drifting sizes, shapes crossing their own edges, idle margin-filling marks
prompt.flux: a doodle in ballpoint on ruled paper, looping unbroken lines, repeated little symbols at drifting sizes, shapes crossing their own edges, the idle marks of a mind wandering in a margin
prompt.sdxl: doodle, ballpoint pen, looping line, repeated symbols, sketchy, notebook margin, black line on white
